title: RelayReview
description: Codex -> WorkBuddy. The reviewer's judgement of a sealed execution report.

verdict.description: approved = plan met and evidence suffices; needs_revision = a specific step failed or drifted; rejected = the approach itself is wrong.

summary.description: 2-4 sentences on what the evidence shows.

findings.description: One entry per planned step. Must cover every step id in the plan.

evidence_checked.description: Which part of the report supports this finding; null if none did.

acceptance_check.description: One entry per acceptance criterion from the plan.

next_action.description: On needs_revision: the specific corrective step to re-plan. On approved: what the user should look at.
